title: PerformanceInterpretation
description: The meaning assigned to a result under defined criteria (CR-MET-006). Carries interpretation_kind, interpretation_state, reference_used, computed variance, narrative. Sibling of AssessmentResult (which carries score); PerformanceInterpretation carries judgment. Variance itself is a derived view (no entity); PerformanceInterpretation is the auditable record of how the variance/threshold/benchmark was interpreted.

external_references.description: CR-3P: identifiers in external systems. Never a substitute for the OpenDEA id (E004).

interprets_observation_ref.description: The MeasurementObservation id being interpreted (relationship dea:interprets).

reference_used.description: Which reference was used (Baseline ref, PerformanceTarget ref, Threshold ref, BenchmarkReference ref).

absolute_variance.description: Computed absolute variance (ObservedValue - ReferenceValue). Optional; populated when interpretation_kind is variance_evaluation.

relative_variance.description: Computed relative variance percentage ((ObservedValue - ReferenceValue) / ReferenceValue * 100). Optional; populated when interpretation_kind is variance_evaluation.

evaluator_ref.description: Who/what performed the interpretation (Actor or system ref).
